## About
Clear Creek Animal Hospital is a full-service veterinary hospital in Seabrook, TX, caring for pets from Seabrook and the surrounding areas. Our team includes Dr. Patricia Parker, Dr. Philip Petersen, Dr. Jana Petersen and Dr. Kimberly Runge.
We focus on preventive care, responsible pet ownership and helping you understand your pet's health. When something more serious comes up, we can help with advanced diagnostics and surgery.
Neighbors have given us a 4.8 rating across 321 Google reviews. One reviewer put it simply: "It’s not just a business to them."

## Services
- Wellness exams and vaccines: Regular checkups and vaccinations to keep your pet healthy and catch problems early.
- Surgical care: Surgical care for your pet, including complex procedures.
- Dental care: Dental care as part of your pet's overall health.
- Fully stocked pharmacy: Pick up your pet's medications right here at the hospital.
- Hospice and euthanasia services: Compassionate support for you and your pet at the end of life.
- Online store: Shop our online store for products we approve and recommend.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of pets do you see?
A: We care for dogs, cats and ferrets.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, on Saturday we're open from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM.

Q: How do I get started as a new patient?
A: You can fill out our new patient registration form from the clinic forms on our website, or give us a call and we'll help you get set up.
